name: What's the difference between fixing and replacing a leaking shower head?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between fixing and replacing a leaking shower head?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixing a leaking shower head typically involves replacing worn-out internal components like O-rings, gaskets, or cartridges, which is often a straightforward and cost-effective solution. Replacing a shower head means installing an entirely new fixture. This is usually done when the existing shower head is old, severely damaged, or when you want to upgrade to a different style, function, or water-saving model. The choice depends on the extent of the damage and your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixing a shower head involves replacing internal parts, while replacing means installing a new fixture for damage or upgrades.
